# Orin AI ecosystem — machine-readable product and routing map
# Canonical home: https://orinai.org/
#
# orinai.org is the front door to the routing service, not a brochure. The
# router at router.orinai.org answers every model request the family makes.

## Orin AI
A unified ecosystem of free AI tools for developers, by Januth Nimnal.
https://orinai.org/ — https://orinai.org/januth-nimnal

## Routing service
Orin Router — one OpenAI-compatible API over many providers, self-hostable.
- Inference: https://router.orinai.org/v1/chat/completions
- Models: https://router.orinai.org/v1/models
- Health: https://router.orinai.org/health
- Free models only: every routable model id ends in `:free`, and the four
  aliases (orin-cheap, orin-balanced, orin-thinking, orin-coding) resolve only
  within that tier.
- Bring your own key: an account can store its own OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq
  or OpenAI credential, and that key is preferred over any platform key.

## Live products
- Orin Chat — Core chat with English, Sinhala, Tamil, research, files, memory, voice, and media: https://chat.orinai.org/
- Orin Code — Windows workspace, CLI, and VS Code extension with Core device auth and workspace-bound tools: https://code.orinai.org/
- Orin Agent — self-hosted local gateway, tools, browser actions, sessions, approvals, and artifacts: https://agent.orinai.org/
- Orin MCP — scoped hosted and stdio model access: https://mcp.orinai.org/
- Orin Tools — keyless web search is live; public code execution remains disabled until an Orin-controlled sandbox passes review: https://tools.orinai.org/

## Preview products
- Orin Console — isolated PTY sessions with replay, no login, and an 8-hour expiry: https://console.orinai.org/
- Orin Automations — local pipeline compiler, exact-hash approvals, safe runner, and Logseq notes: https://automate.orinai.org/

## Accounts
Chat, Code, Agent, Router and MCP require an Orin account. Console, Tools and
Automations do not. Bring-your-own-key credentials are stored against the
account, so they follow the user across devices.
